name: OPERATION MANUAL A
content:
OPERATION MANUAL A - BASIC MOVEMENT. 

Use WASD to move your character and the left mouse to rotate the camera.

Holding shift whilst moving will allow you to sprint for a time.

Holding C will allow you to crouch under certain obstacles.|Click and hold the left mouse button to use the flashlight but be aware of the noise it generates.

F will allow you to interact with the environment when an indicator is displayed.|Use I to open your inventory to check your status, items, files, and change the options, I and ESC can be used to close the inventory when it is open.|Finally...|good luck.
